name: Antipodal Six-Code Class
definition: On coordinates $x_0,x_1,x_2,x_3$, the **antipodal six-code class** is $$\mathcal C_6^{\pm}=\{\mathtt{0000},\mathtt{1100},\mathtt{1010},\mathtt{0101},\mathtt{0011},\mathtt{1111}\},$$ where each word lists its labels in the displayed coordinate order. It consists of three complementary pairs of binary words.
comments: A finite, independently verified separation between projected no-clashing teaching dimension one and labeled sample compression two. No asymptotic separation or novelty claim is asserted.
